description:
Use answer_query to get a grounded, synthesized conceptual answer to a high-level question about Google developer products. For exact code samples, CLI flags, specific error messages, or full document walkthroughs, prefer `search_documents` followed by `get_documents` instead. This tool has limited quota. This tool will synthesize information from the corpus to generate an answer to the query. answer_query grounds answers using the same corpus as search_documents. 
This tool returns the generated answer_text and a list of document names (references) used to generate the answer. Always cite the authoritative source document names from `references` (`documents/...`) in your final response to the user. Use `get_documents` with the document names from `references` to fetch the entire document content if needed.

If you get a 429 out of quota error, use search_documents instead.
name: answer_query

references.description: Output only. The resource names of the documents used to generate the answer (e.g., `documents/docs.cloud.google.com/storage/docs/creating-buckets`). Cite these resource names in the final response and pass them to `get_documents` if full document content is needed.
